title: norregel: a preregistered benchmark of dated numeric values in Norwegian law
abstract: arXiv:2610.29207v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: norregel asks language models for numeric values in Norwegian statutes, regulations and parliamentary decisions (NOK amounts, percentages, multiples of the National Insurance basic amount (G) and age limits), each at a stated date. The 916 items were extracted mechanically from Lovdata's open data, and each carries the dated history of its provision, so an answer can be classed as correct, outdated, wrong or uninterpretable. We report a first and a second preregistered run on the same items. In the first run (five models, listed publicly only after local analysis), H1, that outdated answers are more frequent for values that took effect after a model's cutoff, could not be tested in substance, and H2 and H3 were inconclusive; Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 4.6 answered 46.7% and 40.2% of the 880 primary items correctly. translated_title: norregel：挪威法律中带日期数值的预注册基准
translated_abstract: norregel要求语言模型回答挪威法律、法规和议会决议中的数值（挪威克朗金额、百分比、国民保险基本金额（G）的倍数以及年龄限制），每个数值都对应一个特定日期。916个条目从Lovdata的开放数据中机械提取，每个条目都带有其条款的带日期历史记录，因此答案可以被分类为正确、过时、错误或无法解释。我们报告了在相同条目上进行的第一次和第二次预注册运行。在第一次运行中（五个模型，仅在当地分析完成后才公开列出），假设H1（即对于在模型截止日期之后生效的数值，过时答案更频繁）实际上无法测试，H2和H3的结果也不确定；Opus 5.5和Sonnet 4.6在880个主要条目中分别正确回答了46.7%和40.2%。第二次运行在任何调用之前就完成了预注册并发布，分析了八个模型。其汇总的主要测试……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了norregel——一个预注册的基准测试，用于评估语言模型对挪威法律中随时间变化的数值知识的掌握，结果显示即使是表现最好的模型在主要条目上的正确率也不到一半，揭示了语言模型在法律数值知识方面的重大缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces norregel, a preregistered benchmark evaluating language models on dated numeric values in Norwegian law, revealing that even the best-performing models answer fewer than half of the primary items correctly, exposing significant gaps in models' legal numeric knowledge.
